comments.html: I love the writing in this one.

comments.author: Smiles
comments.html:
You must lead a very interesting life, to write so eloquently representative of a semi-sociopathic look at relationships. And especially later in this series to so wonderfully express people’s hidden realities, you must be an incredible read of people and you show very insightful window into understanding how people function (even if that’s in a screwed up way).

Mad respect. Love your work.
